name: @portable-codex/electron-companion
description: Portable Codex cross-platform companion with native Windows fallback and Avalonia desktop shell
author: OpenAI

scripts.build: npm run core:build && npm run desktop:build
scripts.desktop:publish:win: dotnet publish avalonia/PortableCodex.Desktop/PortableCodex.Desktop.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o release-desktop-win
scripts.desktop:publish:mac: dotnet publish avalonia/PortableCodex.Desktop/PortableCodex.Desktop.csproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o release-desktop-mac-arm64
scripts.desktop:publish:mac:x64: dotnet publish avalonia/PortableCodex.Desktop/PortableCodex.Desktop.csproj -c Release -r osx-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o release-desktop-mac-x64
